foundation.badge: Phase 0 complete — foundation and security model
foundation.intro: There is no application to sign in to yet — this page reports what the foundation establishes, and what each remaining phase adds.
foundation.docsNote: Architecture, security model, and schema design are documented in docs/ and decisions/.

domains.title: Two identity domains
domains.body: Platform owners and tenant users live in separate tables, with separate sessions and separate signing secrets. No code path upgrades one into the other.

tenancy.title: Tenancy as a constraint
tenancy.body: Composite foreign keys mean PostgreSQL itself refuses to link a consultant in one organization to a customer in another. Cross-tenant leakage is unrepresentable, not merely untested.

rank.title: Rank rules, not just permissions
rank.body: An actor must strictly outrank a target to act on them, so peers cannot disable each other.

migrations.title: Migrations that run on deploy
migrations.body: Forward-only, checksum-verified, advisory-locked, and wired as Railway's pre-deploy step — so a deploy cannot succeed against an unmigrated database.

env.title: Configuration validated at boot
env.body: Every environment variable is parsed at startup. A missing key fails the deploy by name, rather than throwing on whichever request first needs it.

tokens.title: One place for colour
tokens.body: Every value on this page resolves to a token in globals.css. A hardcoded hex anywhere in src/ is a lint error.
